purpose: Separate account identity, runtime session presence and task role; no filesystem fencing and no replacement of the legacy heartbeat/receipt lease.

response.truncated: boolean; latest 200 with unclosed unexpired entries first

list.visibility: Owner sees all project sessions including archived projects; other callers require an active project grant and a grant on each session's channel. Viewer cannot mutate.

create.status: 201 new; 200 exact idempotent replay without lease extension; 409 different payload or eight active sessions already owned by principal

renew.rules: Own principal only with fresh write ACL/key; expired/closed sessions cannot revive; expiry capped by immutable deadline.

close.rules: Own principal only; idempotently set closed_at. Does not kill a local process or alter legacy presence.

ExecutionSession.freshness: fresh|stale|closed; revoked key/ACL or archived project makes unclosed presence stale

integration.schema: sessionsSchema embedded sessions_schema.sql, execute inside Store.Migrate transaction
integration.live_helper: sessionLive(ctx, querier, project, channel, agent, sessionID) bool; caller still authorizes its current key and task ACL
integration.workspace: Hash only execution_sessions joined to visible_channels, include lifecycle/timestamps and discrete freshness; never a global session counter.

legacy_receipts: New execution session IDs are not accepted by legacy /messages/{id}/receipts; coordination task/report protocol must use its own session binding, not displace principals.session_id.
